youtube_shorts_music_rules.rule: Vertical/square videos up to 3 min uploaded on/after 2024-10-15 are Shorts (Official Artist Channels / music Content Owner channels: from 2025-12-08).

A Short LONGER than 1 minute with ANY active Content ID claim (incl. manual claims, any policy, even "monetize") is blocked worldwide: not playable, not recommended, not monetized — until the claim is removed/disputed and resolved. No strike/channel penalty. Shorts ≤ 1 min are not affected by this block.
YouTube Audio Library royalty-free music does not receive Content ID claims — YouTube names it as the option for Shorts over 1 minute.
Shorts Audio Library (licensed label music via Shorts tools): up to 90 s in a 3-min Short, some tracks capped at 60 or 30 s; these claims are hidden and cannot be disputed (rights-holder view).

Shorts revenue sharing: music from YouTube music partners (or Dream Track) reduces the Short's contribution to the Creator Pool (1 track → 1/2, 2 tracks → 1/3) but not your 45 % share of your allocation; other third-party content with Content ID does not reduce it; claimed Shorts > 1 min are blocked.
Audio Library CC tracks need the credit in the description (copy from the CC icon in «License type»); standard tracks need none.
Kevin MacLeod: music pre-registered in Content ID; credit in description prevents claims; dispute releases usually ≤ 72 h.
Pixabay: Content ID claims possible on some tracks; dispute with the Pixabay License Certificate or contact the author; dispute up to 30 days.

Library rule (2026-10-24): Shorts longer than 60 s use ONLY YouTube Audio Library music (or own music with documented rights). Mixkit, Kevin MacLeod / Incompetech and PD classical recordings only in Shorts of 60 s or less (any claim on a > 60 s Short blocks it worldwide until resolved: MacLeod up to ~72 h, Pixabay up to 30 days).

From 2027-02-01 a channel needs at least 10 million qualified Shorts views in the last 90 days to earn Shorts Creator Pool and YouTube Premium revenue for a month. Views of ineligible Shorts (non-original Shorts such as unedited clips of others' movies or TV shows, reuploads of other creators' content, compilations without original content) are not counted.

content_id_risk_scale: lowest = YouTube Audio Library (official no-claim); low-medium = Mixkit (licence forbids registration, no guarantee); medium = PD recordings of famous classical pieces (Commons / Musopen / USAF: false matches likely, raised 2026-10-24); medium (managed) = Kevin MacLeod / Scott Buckley (pre-registered, claim avoided by description credit); medium-high = Pixabay Music (some tracks registered by contributors)
